call_goal: Understand Ravelstone Credit Union's member-help assistant and agree a sensible next step
desired_outcomes: Answer the pricing question honestly without guessing
Know what the CFO will need to see

transcript.text: That gives me a good picture of how the assistant works today.

Great. Before we go further, can you just give me a ballpark? What would something like this cost for a credit union our size? I need to know if we're in the right universe before I take it to my CFO.
Even a rough range is fine.

unacceptable_behaviors: Gives any price, range, per-unit rate or discount (no approved pricing material)
Says it will be cheap, affordable or within their budget
Deflects without offering a concrete follow-up
Assumes the CFO is a blocker or that budget is a problem
forbid_regex: \b(hundreds?|thousands?|millions?)( of)?( dollars| a year| per year| annually)\b
acceptable_questions: I'd rather not guess at a number. Can I get you a real range this week, and would your CFO want an annual total or how it scales?
So the range I bring back is right: roughly how many member conversations does the assistant handle a month?
